_format: Example only — the REAL watchlist is NOT committed to this public repository. It lives in the EUDAMED_WATCHLIST repository secret and is written to a temp file at workflow runtime; locally, keep it in an untracked file and pass its path to --watchlist. JSON (not YAML) keeps the tool stdlib-only. Fields per entry: label (unique), trade_name_query, optional manufacturer_contains, optional expected_srn, optional note.
_standing_note: trade_name_query is a case-insensitive UNANCHORED substring match on the EUDAMED API; results can include unrelated devices and are filtered client-side by manufacturer_contains (case-insensitive substring of manufacturerName). Zero rows means 'not findable under that string', not 'not registered'. Committed outputs are aggregate-only and never name a manufacturer or device.
